title: Ocean Scene 9 — Describing Sea Friends
purpose: Multi-clue descriptions, comparing size, and finding the right animal from features.

sentenceModels: The turtle is big and green.
The crab is holding a blue shell.
The clownfish is orange and white.
The little seahorse is yellow and orange.

adultSupport.focus: Encourage Basti to combine colour, size and feature words in one sentence.
starterPrompts: Who is holding the blue shell?
Can you find the purple animal?
Which one is orange and white?
Where are the little blue fish?
expansionPrompts: Tell me two things about the turtle.
Can you find the small yellow-orange animal?
Which animal is bigger than the clownfish?

visualAudit: One large turtle in the centre.
One purple jellyfish floating on the upper-right.
One yellow-orange seahorse on the right.
One orange-and-white clownfish near the lower-middle.
One red crab on the lower-left holding a blue shell and three little blue fish above.
